form.name: Name
form.apiKeyKeep: API Key (leave empty to keep the stored one)
form.apiKeyHint: The key is sealed before it is stored; the API never returns it in the clear.
form.modelsHint: Add at least one model; the first is the primary (default). Names must be unique and non-empty.
form.emptyModel: Model name cannot be empty — fill it in or remove the row
form.timeoutHint: e.g. 30s / 1m30s — used both as the request deadline and as the connectivity-check deadline.
form.enabledHint: A disabled provider keeps its configuration but is not handed out.
form.insecureSkipVerifyHint: Only for upstreams with a self-signed cert or a private CA — it removes MITM protection.
form.thinkingHint: Ask the upstream model for its reasoning trace by default; a single request may override it.
